nodes.title: Connector configuration warning states the real requirement
nodes.summary: The one corrective task that corrects connector-configuration-detail-ready-view.tsx's INVALID_CONFIGURATION_WARNING to state truthfully, for every case its own isValid can be false, what the registry actually requires.

nodes.title: NewCaseDraftScreen's stale subject-field test assertions corrected
nodes.summary: The one corrective task that updates four pre-existing test assertions, delivered under the closed frontend-bootstrap initiative, to match the subject field's now-correct shared behavior rather than the bug task/subject-field-fixed-bug/subject-follows-isblocked already removed.

nodes.title: Case-version subject field correctable while draft
nodes.summary: The one corrective task that makes case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx's subject field honor disabled={isBlocked} like every other declared-attribute field, instead of a layout reference's own "fixed/disabled" call overriding what the specification actually decided.

nodes.title: Connector configuration warning states the object requirement, not a JSON-syntax claim
nodes.summary: INVALID_CONFIGURATION_WARNING in connector-configuration-detail-ready-view.tsx states what the registry actually requires — a JSON object — instead of claiming the stored value is not valid JSON, which is false whenever the value is a syntactically valid array or null.

nodes.title: NewCaseDraftScreen's subject-field tests match the shared component's corrected behavior
nodes.summary: Four test assertions in new-case-draft-screen-seed.spec.ts and new-case-draft-screen.spec.ts, still asserting the pre-fix "subject permanently disabled/labeled (fixed)" behavior, now match the shared field component's current, correct behavior.

nodes.title: Subject field honors isBlocked like every other declared attribute
nodes.summary: case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx's subject field is editable while a draft is not blocked, and its label stops asserting the field is fixed.
